name: Ark
description: An Ilmar edge-city lifted whole off its harvested world and turned into a warship, still home to thousands who never leave it. Its heavy and pulse guns are strongest on the flanks, and it carries fighters and troops. Garden domes sit along its top.

name: Hauler
description: A Lode ore hauler, still rust orange, with a few guns bolted on top of its ore bins. The bins are kept as armour and filled with rock. Cheap and weakly armed, it is built to take a beating.

name: Crowbar
description: A Lode ore hull rebuilt as a ram, its bow bent up into a split claw of rock-filled plate. Strong screens and heavy guns to the front and flanks, but no hangar. Walkouts built it to pry a blockade open.

name: Mender
description: Half escort, half hospital, crewed by Growers. Its heavy guns face forward so the lit hospital in its stern never faces the enemy, and it carries a small hangar.

name: Nest
description: A converted Alma liner, still cream and curved, its passenger decks torn out for fighter bays. A weak ship with a big hangar, it hides behind the line. Its pilots live aboard with their ships.

name: Dodger
description: A Runner smuggling ship that learned to fight, with a stolen engine far too big for it mounted high above its stern. Small, fast and hard-hitting for its size. Its tactic is to be somewhere else when the shooting starts.

name: Mule
description: A stubby Runner transport that carries troops anywhere and complains the whole way. Its regiments ride in container cells locked into a cradle beneath it, and the whole cradle drops when it lands. A few light lasers guard its flanks.

name: Barge
description: No guns, all hold: a tall block of container cells built to land a whole militia at once. Its side wall hinges down into one huge ramp, and the troops pour out like a crowd leaving a stadium.

name: Wasp
description: A tiny gunship inside a bristle of long light-laser barrels, turned out from scrap faster than any other hull. Cheap enough to lose, nasty enough to matter. Its crews paint it in Mordant's yellow and black hazard stripes as a joke.

name: Grudge
description: A Statute, the Hand's oldest warship, stolen in the first yard mutiny and kept flying out of spite. Slow and patched, with heavy guns mostly on the flanks and a few fighters and troops. Its name is painted over the registry, large and crooked.

name: Snare
description: A gravity well ship that pulls enemy fleets out of a jump and stops them jumping away. Runners built it from projector drums stolen off Subpoenas, which still carry their Mordant stencils. Light lasers in every direction defend it.

name: Barricade
description: The biggest ship the Collective owns: dead hulls welded into one in a hidden yard. Its whole front face is heavy and pulse guns, and it carries a big hangar. It is built to stand in front of a world and not move.

name: Jubilee
description: The ship that brings the Jubilee to a world: fighters to clear the sky and militia to take the debt registry. Landing ramps fold down along its belly like legs. Its troops burn the local records first.

name: Picket
description: A well-shielded guard ship under a ring of tall shield masts, with the longest-reaching heavy guns in the Collective fleet. It stands off and hits first. Its Locals crews like the name: a picket line is what strikers hold.

name: Homeward
description: The first Ilmar ship built to fight rather than flee, and the best-engineered thing the Collective flies. Heavy and pulse guns crowd both flanks around one tall gun tower. An Ark carries the Ilmar away; a Homeward is meant to take them back.

name: Injunction
description: A short stack of decks with one long rail of heavy turrets along the top that can turn to either end. Long-reaching pulse projectors face forward, and a hold beam under the bow grips its prey. Built to catch a ship and hold it.

name: Writ
description: A small box hull with light-laser clusters on outrigger arms at every corner, so its outline bristles like a burr. It carries nothing but light lasers, made to shred fighters. Slow, it waits for fighters to come to it.

name: Subpoena
description: A plain hull with a tall gravity projector at each corner, glowing dull red when they fire. It summons enemy fleets out of a jump, and they must appear and fight. Light lasers defend it, and it has good sensors.

name: Warrant
description: A long thin spine with the tower at the front and a big grid of engine nozzles at the back, fast and built to look it. Mostly light lasers, with little armour and few screens. The Hand's runner-down of smugglers.

name: Decree
description: An older, shorter and thicker destroyer kept in service. Heavy guns point forward and to the sides, its stern is a blank wall of engines and armour, and grids of missile cells make it the Hand's bombardment ship.

name: Mandate
description: The backbone of the Hand's fleet. Its heavy turrets and pulse domes face forward, deep armour makes up for weak screens, and it carries fighters and troops. The menace is that every Mandate looks exactly like every other Mandate.

name: Edict
description: A battleship and a carrier in one: a slab as long as a city, with a flight deck down its back. It carries the Hand's heaviest forward battery and many fighters and troops. Slow, it relies on its escorts' eyes.

name: Indenture
description: A small troop module in Continuity matte black with the fastest engines in the fleet. Its whole front face is light lasers that clear the landing zone as it comes in. The Tranche aboard has its number chalked on the doors.

name: harvester
description: Lode's mining engine, a flat platform the size of a moon, built to reap dead worlds and pointed at living ones. A harvest removes a system from the map with every fleet there. Its rock breakers are the heaviest guns in the galaxy.

name: Bond
description: An unarmed troop freighter: a bare spine with Lode cargo boxes clamped along it in rows. Its troops travel in the same boxes that carry ore, each stencilled with a contract number. The Collective steals these boxes to build its ships.

name: Decree II
description: The Decree refit, with an oversized engine block on its stern, better screens, pulse guns forward and turrets on the stern at last. More missile cells make it a stronger bombardment ship. The refit took the troop deck for engines.

name: Mandate II
description: The Mandate upgraded with far more heavy and pulse guns at the front and much stronger screens. Rows of emitter masts on every segment give its back a bristle. Refitted Mandates keep their old segment numbers under new ones.

name: Bond II
description: A bigger Bond with a riveted armour shell built over its cargo boxes, so it looks like a closed box rather than a rack. It carries more troops than the Bond and mounts a few light lasers on top.

name: Tender
description: A hollow box frame with Gleaner drones hanging in open racks under a flat deck roof, like stock on warehouse shelves. Light lasers at the corners, no heavy guns and little armour: it stays behind the line.

name: Statute
description: The oldest hull still in service, a law nobody has repealed: riveted plate under an open lattice tower, its grey paint laid on as thick as armour. Slow, with heavy guns mostly on the flanks. The Collective flies stolen Statutes as Grudges.

name: Needle
description: Thin, fast and hard to see coming: a long needle of a hull with the cockpit set far back. Needles hunt Gleaners, because Praevisio can forecast where a drone will be but not where a Needle pilot will go.

name: Maul
description: The heaviest thing a Walkout yard puts in a fighter bay, carrying the most torpedoes and pulse guns. It is built to kill capital ships, not fighters.

name: Swift
description: The Collective's standard fighter and the one on its posters, armed with lasers and torpedoes. Hand-built by Walkouts and fitted to its Dust pilot, it is a single long boom with one wide crescent wing.

name: Plough
description: Slow and sturdy, with pulse guns and torpedoes, it turns over whatever it is sent at. Growers fly most of them, and they named it. A slab-sided hull with a blunt nose like a ploughshare, painted in earth colours.

name: Gleaner
description: Praevisio's pilotless fighter drone, a thin white slab that flies in perfect square formations. Gleaners picked up the last grain after the harvest; these pick off whatever is left after the destroyers.

name: Sickle
description: A narrower, longer drone, sharpened at the front edge, with oversized thrusters at the back. It is the fastest thing the Hand owns.

name: Thresher
description: A pilotless bomber made of stacked drone slabs with a bomb bay between them. Slow and heavy.

name: Winnower
description: A larger drone slab with weapon and shield pods at its corners. It is the drone Praevisio sends after the ones the Gleaners missed.

name: Deckhands
description: The crews who fight from the ships and board whatever they can reach, the better attacker of the Collective's regiments. The Hand throws its Ballast overboard; Deckhands are the people who stay aboard.

name: Militia
description: Dust demolition crews, Local strike guards and Grower rangers under one plain word: cheap, and better at holding ground than taking it. Fewer and worse armed than the Tranches, but nobody here is fighting off a debt.

name: Nhal Lookouts
description: Eyeless Nhal who hear a patrol and feel its weapons' charge long before anyone sees it. The cheapest regiment and weak in a fight, but the best at spotting.

name: Kiru Sparks
description: The Collective's hardest-hitting regiment, and an expensive one. The Kiru live short, fast lives and fight as if every day were the last; in a Kiru regiment it often is.

name: Ilmar Shade Guard
description: The toughest defenders the Collective has, and the best against bombardment. The Ilmar spent their history holding a line of shade against a burning sun, and they dig in under fire the way their cities stood against the day.

name: Pacifiers
description: Continuity's elite riot police and garrison troops in heavy matte black armour. They hold a world down: they are strong against uprisings and good at spotting enemy agents. Each wears a small smile that never reaches the eyes.

name: Ballast
description: Mordant's indentured boarding crews in hazard-yellow yard suits, signed to one hull for life. Ships offload them onto a planet as its garrison, or throw them overboard into a fight.

name: Tranches
description: Continuity's debt soldiers: each regiment is one tranche of bought Birth Debts. Cheap, numerous and spent in waves, they always want to fight, because every confirmed kill is credited against their debt.

name: Proxies
description: Praevisio's line war robots, headless and lean, with a gun built into the right forearm. The Board fights by proxy; the Tranches call them redundancies, because each one makes a squad of them redundant.

name: Lictors
description: Praevisio's elite commando robots: thin, fast and very agile, built to go in first and finish a target before it can move. A low, spider-like machine on tripod legs, it kills by hand with long needle-tipped fingers.

name: Strikers
description: Locals organisers who turn a quiet world into a strike, then the strike into an uprising. Good at espionage and strong leaders. The Hand calls what they do labour disruption.

name: Wreckers
description: Unruled saboteurs who burn registries and blow up toll gates, good at espionage and strong in a fight. Nobody has ever given them an order they followed. They are sent in to make sure a job never gets finished.

name: Spotters
description: Dust pilots in stripped-down Ploughs who go and look. The Hand sends Praevisio's probes; the Collective sends a person.

name: Listeners
description: Ida Hush's network inside Hand cities: cleaners, clerks and night porters who hear everything and are never seen. The best at espionage, with no combat skill at all.

name: Speculators
description: Praevisio's scout probes: flat faceted slates that hover in the air and fan out sensor leaves to watch. A speculator is also someone who bets on what comes next.

name: Auditors
description: Praevisio's spies, because to the Hand espionage is an audit. Forgettable people in grey office suits, linked to Praevisio by a small implant in the temple.

name: Closers
description: Continuity's special forces: in sales, the closer is the one sent in to finish the deal. They move in matte black stealth gear and carry the Aktis, Praevisio's silent laser rifle.

name: Notaries
description: The Chair's own assassins, all human, in spotless dove-white suits. They do not kill you; they certify your death.

name: Repossessors
description: Private debt collectors who hunt people down and repossess them as unpaid balances. Their long coats are sewn with rows of collection tags.

name: Orbital Shipyard
description: Builds capital ships and fighters from refined material. The Hand's shipyards are Mordant's; the Collective builds its ships in hidden yards run by Walkouts.

name: Training Facility
description: Trains troop regiments and special forces from refined material. On Hand worlds the training grounds are Continuity's: each new regiment is a tranche of Birth Debts bought from the Board, and it learns to fight here before it learns what it owes.

name: Construction Yard
description: Builds facilities and planetary defences: mines, refineries, yards, gun batteries and shield generators. On Hand worlds its crews are Contract hands, hired by the job and billed for their own tools.

name: Advanced Shipyard
description: An improved shipyard that builds capital ships and fighters faster than an Orbital Shipyard. It must be researched before it can be built. Mordant gets the speed by running its crews on double shifts, and calls that tradition.

name: Advanced Training Facility
description: An improved training facility that trains troop regiments and special forces faster than a Training Facility. It must be researched before it can be built. Continuity speeds it up by paying recruits their kill bonus in advance, as a loan against their balance.

name: Advanced Construction Yard
description: An improved construction yard that builds facilities and planetary defences faster than a Construction Yard. It must be researched before it can be built. Its crews are paid by the finished job instead of by the day, so nobody stops.

name: Mine
description: Digs raw material out of a world for your refineries to process. On Hand worlds the mines are Lode's, and whole planets are its company towns.

name: Refinery
description: Turns raw material into the refined material every yard builds with. On Hand worlds the refineries are Lode's, and the Hand calls raw and refined material feedstock and product.

name: Sensor Station
description: A listening post on a lane that warns you days ahead when an enemy fleet will pass through or arrive. The Hand's stations are designed by Praevisio's Daedala Voss, and they hear whatever is said near a route.

name: Mordant Lien-150
description: A ground battery of pulse guns. It fires on enemy troops as they land and on ships that bombard the world, draining their screens, and a ship it hits drops no bombs. Mordant names its guns after debt paper: a lien is a claim on what someone owns, and this one claims a ship's screens first.

name: Mordant Covenant I
description: A ground battery of heavy guns. It fires on enemy troops as they land and on ships that bombard the world, hitting their screens and then their hulls. A covenant is the binding promise inside a loan, and these guns keep it: whatever comes down, they fire.

name: Lode Escrow I
description: A shield generator that soaks up part of every bombardment of its world. A world with more than one shield generator cannot be invaded by landing troops. Escrow is money held back until a deal is done, and the Escrow holds back part of every strike. Lode builds them to protect its mines, not the towns beside them.

name: Mordant Covenant II
description: The improved heavy gun battery, hitting far harder than the first model. It fires on enemy troops as they land and on ships that bombard the world. It must be researched before it can be built. Mordant sells it as the same covenant with heavier terms.

name: Lode Escrow II
description: The stronger shield generator, soaking up more of every bombardment than the first model, and it counts toward the shields that stop enemy landings. It must be researched before it can be built. Lode's second escrow holds back more, and bills the world for it.
